metadata.scope: declared reference backgrounds and conditional dust growth; no observation fitting

inputs.epsilon_1e_minus_2: diagnostic only; not asserted observationally allowed
inputs.tstar_role: declared potential/response anchor; not a derived fundamental time
inputs.potential_ratio: Vs/Fchi^2 = 1/(4*tstar_rad^2), held fixed across initial-a checks
inputs.growth_matching: same initial D and physical p; f_i is rescaled by E_ref/E_model

eps0.initial_branch: radiation tracking with first-order dust correction
eps0.early_tail_order: O((Omega_m0*ai/Omega_r0)^2); Lambda omitted in early tail

regular_growth.branch: regular smooth-radiation dust-growth branch; not primordial transfer
regular_growth.radiation_and_scalar_perturbations: omitted; physical use requires subhorizon smooth-field regime

matched_growth.branch: late dust growth with matched initial D and physical canonical momentum
